3-307.11
(All) Food not protected from contamination from other sources.
RECOMMENDED RESOLUTION: Food shall be protected from contamination that may result from a factor or source not specified under Subparts 3-301- 3-306. This deficiency must be corrected within a maximum of 90 days.
OBSERVATIONS & CORRECTIVE ACTIONS: Ice build up on ceiling of walk in freezer and on speed rack in walk in freezer Observed non food grade container being used to store chicken (large storage tote) discussed only food grade containers can be used to store food, other containers are made of recycled plastics that can be toxic for food.
4-903.11
(A,B,D) Cleaned equipment and utensils not stored appropriately.
RECOMMENDED RESOLUTION: Cleaned equipment and utensils, laundered linens, and single-service and single-use articles shall be stored: in a clean, dry location; where they are not exposed to splash, dust, or other contamination; and at least 15 cm (6 inches) above the floor. Clean equipment and utensils shall be stored as specified and shall be stored: in a self-draining position that allows air drying; and covered or inverted. This deficiency must be corrected within a maximum of 90 days.
OBSERVATIONS & CORRECTIVE ACTIONS: Clean plates are stored next to handwashing sink without a splash guard; subject to splash
3-302.11
(A) Cross-contamination of cooked and/or ready-to-eat foods with raw animal products not adequately prevented in storage, preparation, holding, and display.
RISK FACTOR/INTERVENTIONCorrected On Site
RECOMMENDED RESOLUTION: All raw animal products (poultry, beef, pork, eggs, etc.) must be stored or prepared in a manner that prevents cross-contamination with ready-to-eat foods by storing them on separate shelves, in separate units, or having a partition between them. Additionally, raw animal products must be prepared using separate cleaned and sanitized equipment, in different locations or at different times than ready-to-eat foods. This deficiency must be corrected within 3 days.
OBSERVATIONS & CORRECTIVE ACTIONS: Observed raw chicken stored above raw shell eggs; COS=raw shell eggs moved above raw chicken; Observed employee food stored on top shelf in single door pepsi cooler, raw shell eggs on this shelf stored above cooked shrimp, milk; COS=moved employee food to bottom shelf when notified. Discussed employee food should always been separated to prevent contamination of food for consumers.
2-102.11
Adequate daily cold holding logs are maintained. This facility exceeds regulatory requirements by practicing active managerial control by monitoring and recording internal food temperatures for food items that are under cold holding. Bonus credit has been awarded based on inspector observations of temperature records meeting specific FCCHD criteria.
RISK FACTOR/INTERVENTION
RECOMMENDED RESOLUTION: Continue upholding high food safety standards by maintaining this managerial control. Consider increasing the frequency of monitoring to an interval of every four hours to further enhance food safety and earn additional bonus credit.
OBSERVATIONS & CORRECTIVE ACTIONS: Facility is maintaining daily temperature logs for all cold holding.
